At observed block 129455194 root paused=false, flashNotEnable=false, cancelNotEnable=true, penaltyRate=50/10000, WAITING_TIME=604800 seconds; these mutable observations are not continuing availability guarantees. cancelClaim is excluded because its guard is currently disabled.

stake_66380860 pulls configured supported token from msg.sender into the vault, credits that same caller financial ledger and mints configured zkToken shares. Amounts use underlying raw units; observed BNB USDT/USDC use 18-decimal amount conventions with minimum resulting caller principal 10e18 and maximum uint256. Share conversion uses 1e18-scaled exchange rate and integer floor; no caller minimum shares/slippage bound.

Reward amounts accrue from administrator-configured rate history and principal/time accounting, not an independently attested investment return or reserve valuation. Public docs describe Ceffu/Binance MirrorX and funds leaving the vault for CeFi strategies. Administrators/bots can alter rates, limits, waiting time, fee, supported tokens and move capital; no backing, solvency, yield or strategy safety guarantee.

requestClaim_8135334 consumes caller accumulated rewards before principal, accepts uint256 max for all recorded assets, burns caller zkToken shares (floored conversion, capped to balance/all balance if principal exhausted) and creates a caller-owned token-specific queue item. Pending amount stops participating in stake/reward totals. claim_41202704 requires matching owner/token, unclaimed positive amount and elapsed recorded claimTime, then marks done and asks fixed WithdrawVault to pay msg.sender.

Current fixed WithdrawVault is 0xe2c7925b1173013a59b8573daa3eda6c613ded45; observed paused=false and vault() equals root. Its transfer requires VAULT_ROLE, supported token and funded balance. Complete separate dependency ABI/source retained, but no direct helper capability admitted. Queue maturity does not guarantee funds, successful payout or service deadline.

flashWithdrawWithPenalty consumes own recorded reward/principal and burns own zkToken, transfers only to msg.sender from available root liquidity, and floors payout totalAmount*(10000-penaltyRate)/10000. uint256 max means all recorded assets. Mutable fee and liquidity apply; no caller minimum output. No token authorization, arbitrary executor, bridge, role/admin, delegated payer or backend signing surface admitted.

EnforcedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is paused.

ExpectedPause().details: The operation failed because the contract is not paused.

AccessControlBadConfirmation().details: The caller of a function is not the expected one. NOTE: Don't confuse with {AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount}.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

RoleGranted(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is granted `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call. This account bears the admin role (for the granted role). Expected in cases where the role was granted using the internal {AccessControl-_grantRole}.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address,address).details: Emitted when `account` is revoked `role`. `sender` is the account that originated the contract call:   - if using `revokeRole`, it is the admin role bearer   - if using `renounceRole`, it is the role bearer (i.e. `account`)

RoleAdminChanged(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32.details: Emitted when `newAdminRole` is set as ``role``'s admin role, replacing `previousAdminRole` `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` is the starting admin for all roles, despite {RoleAdminChanged} not being emitted signaling this.

pause().details: Pauses the contract, disabling `transfer` functionality. Can only be called by an account with the PAUSER_ROLE.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

unpause().details: Unpauses the contract, enabling `transfer` functionality. Can only be called by an account with the PAUSER_ROLE.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

supportingAbis.role: Fixed withdrawal payout dependency, no directly admitted functions

sourceSemantics: stake_66380860 pulls configured supported token from msg.sender into the vault, credits that same caller financial ledger and mints configured zkToken shares. Amounts use underlying raw units; observed BNB USDT/USDC use 18-decimal amount conventions with minimum resulting caller principal 10e18 and maximum uint256. Share conversion uses 1e18-scaled exchange rate and integer floor; no caller minimum shares/slippage bound.

Reward amounts accrue from administrator-configured rate history and principal/time accounting, not an independently attested investment return or reserve valuation. Public docs describe Ceffu/Binance MirrorX and funds leaving the vault for CeFi strategies. Administrators/bots can alter rates, limits, waiting time, fee, supported tokens and move capital; no backing, solvency, yield or strategy safety guarantee.

requestClaim_8135334 consumes caller accumulated rewards before principal, accepts uint256 max for all recorded assets, burns caller zkToken shares (floored conversion, capped to balance/all balance if principal exhausted) and creates a caller-owned token-specific queue item. Pending amount stops participating in stake/reward totals. claim_41202704 requires matching owner/token, unclaimed positive amount and elapsed recorded claimTime, then marks done and asks fixed WithdrawVault to pay msg.sender.

Current fixed WithdrawVault is 0xe2c7925b1173013a59b8573daa3eda6c613ded45; observed paused=false and vault() equals root. Its transfer requires VAULT_ROLE, supported token and funded balance. Complete separate dependency ABI/source retained, but no direct helper capability admitted. Queue maturity does not guarantee funds, successful payout or service deadline.

flashWithdrawWithPenalty consumes own recorded reward/principal and burns own zkToken, transfers only to msg.sender from available root liquidity, and floors payout totalAmount*(10000-penaltyRate)/10000. uint256 max means all recorded assets. Mutable fee and liquidity apply; no caller minimum output. No token authorization, arbitrary executor, bridge, role/admin, delegated payer or backend signing surface admitted.
limitations: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, coverage, capital safety, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, policy and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; nonpayable methods require zero native value.
